nodes.description: Boolean state variable tracking whether the contract has been initialized.
Address of the OHM ERC20 token whose supply is measured; set once at initialization.
Address of the contract owner, controls privileged setters and ownership transfer.
Array of addresses whose OHM balances are excluded from circulating supply.
External one-time initializer that sets the OHM token address; guarded only by msg.sender == owner and isInitialized == false.
External view returning total OHM supply minus non-circulating OHM; performs an external call to the OHM token.
Public view looping over nonCirculatingOHMAddresses and summing IERC20(OHM).balanceOf of each address via external calls.
External owner-only function replacing the whole non-circulating address array.
External owner-only function transferring ownership to a new address; no zero-address or renouncement check.
Constructor assigning the initial owner from the deployment argument.
Caller-controlled address used for all owner authentication checks.
External call to an attacker-influenceable token contract returning totalSupply.
External call to the OHM token for each non-circulating address inside a loop; result trusted without validation.
Constructor argument supplying the initial owner address.
Caller-supplied OHM token address written into the OHM state variable; unvalidated.
Caller-supplied array assigned wholesale to the nonCirculatingOHMAddresses state array.
Caller-supplied address that becomes the new owner; no zero-address check.
Local holding the externally returned totalSupply value.
Local computed as _totalSupply.sub(getNonCirculatingOHM()).
Accumulator summing external balanceOf results across the address array.
Loop index iterating over nonCirculatingOHMAddresses.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _owner is written directly into the owner state variable with no zero-address validation, letting a bad initial owner permanently control privileges.
Constructor performs the state write of owner from its argument.
initialize authenticates the caller using msg.sender == owner, the sole access-control gate for setting the OHM token address.
The owner state variable is read and compared against msg.sender inside initialize.
Caller-supplied _ohm is assigned to the OHM state variable; whoever calls initialize first controls which token contract is queried.
isInitialized is checked to gate initialize, but the check combined with the external call ordering is the only one-time guard.
initialize writes isInitialized = true after setting OHM.
setNonCirculatingOHMAddresses authenticates the caller using msg.sender == owner before mutating supply-relevant state.
Caller-supplied array is assigned wholesale to the nonCirculatingOHMAddresses state array, replacing all exclusion entries.
transferOwnership authenticates the caller using msg.sender == owner before changing the privileged owner.
Caller-supplied _owner overwrites the owner state variable; no zero-address check allows ownership to be lost or set to an unintended address.
OHMCirculatingSupply performs an external call to the OHM token totalSupply, an external contract that could be malicious/untrusted.
Return value of the external totalSupply call is stored in _totalSupply without validation.
OHM state variable is cast to IERC20 to make the totalSupply external call.
_totalSupply participates in sub() to compute circulating supply; a manipulated non-circulating total can underflow the subtraction (SafeMath reverts).
OHMCirculatingSupply invokes getNonCirculatingOHM to obtain the subtractive amount.
Computed _circulatingSupply is returned from OHMCirculatingSupply.
getNonCirculatingOHM performs an external balanceOf call to the OHM token for each address in the loop.
Each external balanceOf result is added to the _nonCirculatingOHM accumulator without validating the token contract.
getNonCirculatingOHM reads the nonCirculatingOHMAddresses state array to drive its loop.
Loop index i indexes nonCirculatingOHMAddresses; array length is owner-controlled, allowing unbounded gas growth that can brick supply queries.
OHM state variable is cast to IERC20 inside getNonCirculatingOHM for balance lookups.
_nonCirculatingOHM accumulator is returned by getNonCirculatingOHM.
Non-circulating OHM total feeds the subtraction that yields circulating supply, so a manipulated value affects the arithmetic result.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor argument exists only to seed the owner state variable and has no independent identity outside the constructor body.
_ohm is a transient input used solely to write the OHM state variable inside initialize.
The argument is a direct alias of the state array assignment and carries no separate semantics.
_owner is only a temporary holder of the value written into the owner state variable.
Local variable that merely stores the result of the external totalSupply call within one function.
Return-value local computed and immediately returned; should be folded into the enclosing function node.
Accumulator local used only for the return value of the loop summation.
Loop counter local whose only purpose is to index the state array during iteration.
